Such a good app. I only use the free version but it is so crucial to my success in the gym. Just use it!

I had worked out for about a year and a half and while I was making decent progress, I wasn’t where I thought I should be.  My friend Dan suggested keeping a Gym log to track my progress for each individual exercise, rep, and weight.  He keeps a written log.  I know myself well enough to know that I am not going to last long writing in a log, much less going back and analyzing it.  I thought, “there has to be a better way!!” I was just winging it from week to week unsure what weights and reps I had used the prior week and it was not efficient.  I searched for a workout log in the App Store and Hevy was the one that grabbed my eye first.  I knew nothing about them and just wanted to try one out. I liked the ease of use on the app.  I have tracked every single rep since I downloaded it.  That’s when I started making real progress.  Okay, I did 20 reps with 40lbs last week, let’s push it more next week.  The guesswork was gone from it.  It shows you your previous set data from your last workout and when you surpass your previous best it pops up reward showing such.  I make it a goal to set new PRs each month.  Love the app after 50 workouts with it and will continue to use it.
W app, optimal

I love this app. The workout tracking is easy especially if you do a lot of heavy lifting. It is very intuitive and beginner friendly to use. It sync perfectly with my Apple Watch. I love this app so much. It’s easy to use and has great options to choose from for my workouts. I love how it tracks my workouts and celebrates my progress along with me.
This app was there for me at the start of my weight loss and strength training journey. It has not let me down and continues to be a successful asset for me.
Great app for lifting. Easy to share workouts and modify routines

I’ve been working out for a long time, and generally thought I knew my routine in my head.  I thought I knew what weight I was using, how many reps, what exercise.  

I thought I knew that I was successfully moving into progressive overload.  All in my head. Yeah right. 

I found out about Hevy from my son, and I can tell you after almost 4 months, the difference in my progress has been so much better.  Knowing exactly what I did last time, what the weight was, how many reps makes it so much easier and efficient and most importantly, productive. I’m so glad I found this app.

title.label: Hevy has been a game-changer for my training.

Seeing those previous numbers right there keeps me honest and motivated — I’ve hit several new personal records on movements that used to stall. Clean interface, solid progress tracking, and it actually helps me lift more. Highly recommend.
